## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **The island focus/selection accent is neutral, not amber.** The
   islands' `hsl(28deg 80% 45–55%)` focus/selection orange sat inside
   the band K14 reserves for the provisional state — it now rides
   `--sig-ink`/`--sig-link` (the focus ring keeps its shape + stroke
   channel; selection keeps stroke-width 2 vs 1).
2. **Sub-step spacing snapped to the scale.** Legacy `0.1–0.9 rem`
   gaps/paddings rounded onto the 4 px ramp; the largest visible delta
   is `0.62–0.85 rem` micro-copy now on the 13/14 px floor steps — that
   floor is the design (NEW-5), not a regression. Named exceptions
   kept: `margin: -1px` (visually-hidden), `@page 2 cm` print margin,
   `top: 50%` positioning, `-9999px` off-screen, the 3 px focus ring on
   `outline` (a spec'd constant, not rhythm).
3. **Dark support-ramp anchors flip; ordinality doesn't.** On the dark
   surface the lightness direction inverts so "most support" stays the
   most contrasting step — the test asserts monotonicity per context,
   not a fixed direction.
4. **The served `/map/style.json` colours change.** The style artifact
   now names the shared data-blue (its old navy literals were the same
   hue family — a restatement, not a re-palette) while the island gains
   the same values — the two previously-forked palettes converge.
5. **`.sig-provisional` ships as a style primitive, not lexicon copy.**
   The wording is P36.17's row; this row lands the dashed-amber
   primitive + tokens it renders so the hue is already single-meaning
   when the copy lands.
